summary: Catalog database pool exhaustion after pool size reduction
root_cause: Connection pool configured below peak concurrency
resolution: Restored pool size and added pool saturation alert

summary: Recommendation workers OOMKilled after unbounded cache growth
root_cause: Feature cache had no size or eviction policy
resolution: Added bounded LRU cache and memory limit tests

summary: Search latency during campaign traffic spike
root_cause: CPU saturation because autoscaling reached its replica maximum
resolution: Raised replica maximum and added load shedding

summary: Shipping quote failures after client timeout reduction
root_cause: Client timeout was lower than normal shipping-service latency
resolution: Restored timeout and added latency-based configuration test

summary: Existing profiles rejected after serializer schema change
root_cause: New required field was not backward compatible with stored profiles
resolution: Made field optional and backfilled existing profiles

summary: SMTP delivery outage caused by expired TLS certificate
root_cause: Certificate renewal automation did not cover internal SMTP endpoint
resolution: Renewed certificate and added expiry monitoring

summary: Image processing failed when temporary volume filled
root_cause: Temporary files were not cleaned after successful conversions
resolution: Cleaned volume and added lifecycle cleanup

summary: Shipment events delayed by queue consumer under-capacity
root_cause: Consumer replica count was too low for arrival rate
resolution: Scaled consumers and added queue-depth autoscaling

summary: Session creation failed after invalid DNS configuration
root_cause: Configured hostname had no internal DNS record
resolution: Restored prior hostname and added deployment DNS validation
